description: Open the brief's automation in the builder: its draft, or once Generate published it its live version (saving an edit of it makes a new automation); another automation opens read-only.

board_id.description: The open Shoot Board's board_id, from Open Shoot Board or your context.

read_only.description: Show a published version (version_id, else the live one) without opening a draft: a brief that ran shows what it ran, the board's pinned Automation its live version.

version_id.description: The published version to show (an automation, or read_only); a brief recipe opened to edit always opens its draft.

name: mcp_recipe_open
title: Open Automation
